author: nottherealtar
install_msg: `/passgen` opens the button menu, or `/passgen length:16` for a quick DM. Password is never posted in the channel.
name: passgen
description: Button/select UI to choose password length and symbol style, then DMs the result. Optional length argument (6–32) for quick generation. No persistence.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
